notes.title: Nominate Zoeti for Best Soundtrack
notes.content:
Hey adventurers,

First off, thank you for the amazing release of [i]Zoeti[/i]. It has been great to be able to share with you the beautiful heart wrenching story that [i]Zoeti [/i]tells.

Steam Awards voting starts now! The Steam Awards are a community-voted celebration of the best games on Steam, announced every year. There are many categories that we can vote for however it is best we unite to vote on one category for [i]Zoeti[/i]!!

We're asking players to band together and vote [i]Zoeti [/i]for [b]Best Soundtrack[/b].

Every song has been carefully crafted for their section in the game. From the relaxing sounds of Serene Evening when you are resting, to the quick tempo of A Lone Blue Knight during battle there is a wide range of songs.

You can listen to these songs here!
https://youtu.be/FW-357nSuGE?si=s1iD0aaREoSFR3c_

What is your favorite song?

- Riv Otter

notes.title: v1.0.27 update
notes.content:
Change: Difficulty balance adjustments, with a decrease in difficulty for the Normal, Hard, Thrilling, and Nightmare levels.
Change: Monster difficulty in parts of Story 2 and Story 3 has been lowered.
Add: New town dialogue events have been added to Story 3.
Add: Healing events have been added to the random event points in Story1 and Story2. (When the player's HP is below 40%, there is a 70% chance of triggering it once).
Fix: Language and text optimization has been improved to address certain option texts exceeding two lines, as well as adjusting certain accessory descriptions.
Fix: Skill adjustments and description errors have been corrected.
Fix: Special effects used by certain items have been fixed.

notes.title: Zoeti is out now!
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

[b]Oil your armor, sharpen your blades, and prepare your spells, [i]Zoeti[/i] is now out![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2VCnbPaE7ck

Zoeti is a turn-based roguelite that features a deck of playing cards used to create card combos and activate skills in the heat of battle. Bolster your arsenal through battles, discoverable upgrades, or aid from the locals which enhance your plays to overcome the evil plaguing your land.

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A Royal Flush[/b] - Every ability is associated with a poker hand; the more complex the hand, the more impactful the ability!
[*] [b]Create a Powerful Arsenal[/b] - Upgrade, purchase, or quest for new skills for your runs. Discover new synergies to overcome your opposition and create mechanically rich strategies.
[*] [b]Your Choices Have Consequences[/b] - Risk everything on a tough fight with an exceptional reward or take the easy path to guarantee victory.
[*] [b]Meet Fuzzy Friends[/b] - From Winfred the cheerful innkeeper with a powerful secret to Rabelle, the devious scoundrel just as likely to trick you as to help you.
[*] [b]Endless Possibilities[/b] - Three different game modes playable with three different characters at five different difficulties featuring dozens of different builds and hundreds of different enemies... Every run is unique!
[/list]

[b]To celebrate the launch of Zoeti, Zoeti is launching with a 10% discount![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1434540/Zoeti/ 

Remember to give Zoeti a review when you play it!

-Riv Otter

notes.title: Map Pathing Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

I’m excited to finally talk about Zoeti and some of the strategies that go into each run! In this dev log, I’m going to break down the choices that go into your decisions on the map. In the future, I’ll talk about each turn, the different character playstyles, and more.

Choosing the best path will be a foundational skill for each run you begin. One wrong move on the map can lead to the run ending or receiving tons of preventable damage. Each path will have its own layout and rewards for completing them and those rewards can be sand dollars that you use in shops, accessory items to help in battle, skills to refine your build, items which can swing a battle, and soulstone fragments which help you upgrade your abilities. Understanding which each path brings will help evaluate the risks and rewards of each path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/b01948c6f6293f9f1500217faa06c158b8d9431c.png[/img]

Each node in the path contains a different interaction that triggers when you arrive there the lines connecting the nodes show where you can travel next.  At the end of the path, there will be a special encounter such as an elite battle or boss that you must face in order to continue on.

[h2]Type of Spaces[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/26bafbe0b823ac0bfe8be1a86325d3ab092de61d.png[/img]

[h3]Enemy[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/bbdfd710f70653836cb7ca5c256ba3fa0fe29c28.png[/img]
The enemy will be the most common node on the path. Here you can expect a battle with various enemies. For beating the enemies, you can gain sand coins for shops, soulstone fragments to upgrade your character, and a skill to add to your deck.

[h3]Shop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/d05ebda85025c90b3cdea2ebe86c75ff63ac6241.png[/img]
At shop nodes, you can use your sand coins to buy accessories and items. Accessories are passive buffs that affect battle and items help turn the tide of battle when you activate them.

[h3]Campfire[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/40886e0c353db7ef0d464a04dbf38dee2110a119.png[/img]
Campfire nodes allow you to heal and mediate. You can rest, healing 25% of your hp and meditate, upgrading your skills or abilities using soulstone fragments. These are most common right before the end of the path.

[h3]Idol[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/0829ba6ddc1a106f21a07edc576ba9a4dfd81c0f.png[/img]
When you go to an idol node, you will discover an idol to one of the game’s four gods that will give you up to four different options. Early in the game, you’ll be presented with two choices: One free, one costing a small amount for a small boon. But as you progress deeper, idols will progressively offer you more and more powerful accessories and items for higher and higher costs.. Different idols will have different rewards and costs, depending on which of the four gods you’re asking for favor. Keep an eye out for another devlog in the not-too-distant future showing off the four gods and what powerful items they have on offer!.

[h3]Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379674/a8065805d007aca9967fd1fc82435cbc7cfb61de.png[/img]
You have made it! You hit the final node at the end of the path where you will have your toughest fight! Will it be a boss monster demanding all your skill, power and cunning? Will it be an elite battle, pitting you against a collection of the strongest fiends on the field? Will it be an event battle, where you fight against waves of enemies without the opportunity to rest? Will you need to defend on the altars of the gods from assailing monsters, teaming up with other star envoys to do so? Depends on your map and its pathing!

That is everything in the map! Remember to choose your path carefully and plan ahead in your route. That can be the difference between a successful run and a failed one. My good friend Buddy has been streaming Zoeti on Fridays, which will include this upcoming Friday for some brand new game content!. If you would like to get notified when he goes live, join the Akupara Games Discord!

- Riv Otter
